nba2af1ca4c1.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Andhra spokesmen of the Moderate era?
o: P. Anandacharlu was secretary of the Madras Mahajana Sabha in 1884.
Nyapathi Subbarao founded the Godavari District Association.
P. Anandacharlu presented the data-led drain critique at the 7th Andhra Mahasabha, Guntur, 1919.
Gadicherla Harisarvottama Rao critiqued the economic drain from Madras against Andhra in 1919.
nba2af1ca4c1.x: The data-led drain critique at the 7th Andhra Mahasabha in Guntur (1919) was presented by Gadicherla Harisarvottama Rao, not P. Anandacharlu.

n206318f3766.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Bipin Chandra Pal's Rajahmundry visit of April 1907?
o: He stayed there from 19 to 24 April 1907.
He opened the Godavari Swadeshi Stores.
n206318f3766.x: Pal delivered five lectures at Rajahmundry (19-24 April 1907), not seven, and opened the Godavari Swadeshi Stores.

n702d583479c.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Swadeshi movement in Andhra?
o: It was popularly known as the Vandemataram Movement.
It was popularly known in Andhra as the Home Rule Movement.
Its Andhra phase lasted from 1906 to 1911.
n702d583479c.x: In Andhra the Swadeshi agitation was popularly called the Vandemataram Movement; the Home Rule Movement came later (1916).

n4817c07ed10.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Bipin Chandra Pal's Andhra tour of April 1907?
o: He was at Kakinada on 17 April.
n4817c07ed10.x: The tour began at Vizianagaram (16 April); Pal reached Rajahmundry only from 19 April, after Kakinada (17 April).

ndcc1de4aed7.s: Who banned Vandemataram badges and the slogan at the Rajahmundry college in April 1907?
ndcc1de4aed7.x: Mark Hunter, Principal of the Rajahmundry Arts and Teachers' Training College, banned Vandemataram badges and the slogan in April 1907.

new.s: Which body was founded first among these?
new.x: The Madras Mahajana Sabha (1884) came before the first INC (1885), the Krishna District Association (1892) and Krishna Patrika (1902).

new.s: Who founded the Madras Native Association in 1852?
new.x: Gazula Lakshmi Narasu Chetty founded the Madras Native Association (26 February 1852) and was its first president.

new.s: The Madras Mahajana Sabha was founded in:
new.x: The Madras Mahajana Sabha was founded on 16 May 1884, with P. Rangaiah Naidu as president and P. Anandacharlu as secretary.

new.s: Who was the first secretary of the Madras Mahajana Sabha (1884)?
new.x: P. Anandacharlu was the secretary; P. Rangaiah Naidu was the president of the Sabha.

new.s: P. Anandacharlu presided over the 7th INC session of 1891 held at:
new.x: P. Anandacharlu, the first Telugu INC president, presided over the 7th session at Nagpur in 1891.

new.s: Which Andhra delegate at the first INC session (Bombay, 1885) came from Rajahmundry?
new.x: Nyapathi Subbarao represented Rajahmundry; Anandacharlu was from Chittoor, Kesava Pillai from Gooty and Venkata Subbarayudu from Machilipatnam.

new.s: How many Andhra delegates attended the Madras session of the INC in 1914?
new.x: The Madras session of 1914 had 256 Andhra delegates.

new.s: Which of the following was NOT a demand of the first INC session (1885)?
o: Simultaneous ICS examinations in England and India
new.x: The first session opposed the annexation of Upper Burma; the other three were its demands.

new.s: Which Andhra spokesman held the titles 'Rajabahadur' and 'Padyavinoda'?
new.x: Nyapathi Subbarao, the Rajahmundry lawyer and Andhra spokesman, bore the titles Rajabahadur and Padyavinoda.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the Andhra Moderates:
1. They repeated the INC's economic critique of the drain of wealth.
2. P. Anandacharlu attended the first INC session.
3. Nyapathi Subbarao was a Rajahmundry lawyer.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: All three are correct: the Andhra Moderates echoed the drain critique, Anandacharlu attended the 1st INC, and Subbarao was a Rajahmundry lawyer.

new.s: Who founded the Krishna District Association?
new.x: Ramaswamy Gupta founded the Krishna District Association (1892); Nyapathi Subbarao presided over its conference.

new.s: The Godavari District Association was founded at Rajahmundry in 1895 by:
new.x: Nyapathi Subbarao founded the Godavari District Association at Rajahmundry in 1895.

new.s: An 1899 resolution of the Krishna District Association led to the founding of:
new.x: The Krishna District Association's 1899 resolution led to Krishna Patrika (1902).

new.s: Which pair of district association and founding year is correctly matched?
new.x: Nellore was founded in 1908; Vizag was 1893, Kurnool 1914 and Anantapur 1907.

new.s: The first Telugu journal, Satyadoota, was brought out by:
new.x: Satyadoota, the first Telugu journal, was published by the Bellary Christian mission.

new.s: Krishna Patrika (1902) was founded at Machilipatnam by Konda Venkatappayya and:
new.x: Krishna Patrika was founded on 2 February 1902 by Konda Venkatappayya and Dasu Narayana Rao; Mutnuri Krishna Rao edited it later.

new.s: Which Andhra leader brought out the monthly Vyjayanti?
new.x: Vyjayanti, a monthly, and the People's Magazine were associated with Nyapathi Subbarao.

new.s: About how many Telugu journals existed by 1905?
new.x: About 20 Telugu journals, such as Deshabhimani, Sasilekha and Gowtami, existed by 1905.

new.s: Guntur district was carved out of Krishna district in:
new.x: Guntur district was carved from Krishna in 1904, and Konda Venkatappayya moved there.

new.s: Who was the leading municipal figure of Rajahmundry and founder of the Hindu Samaj there?
new.x: Nyapathi Subbarao led Rajahmundry's municipal politics and founded the Hindu Samaj there.

new.s: Who said, 'Bengal united is a power; Bengal divided will pull in several different ways'?
new.x: Home Secretary H.H. Risley made this remark, revealing the real motive of weakening Bengali nationalism.

new.s: Who was the Viceroy when the partition of Bengal was annulled in 1911?
new.x: Lord Hardinge II was Viceroy at the 1911 Delhi Durbar of George V; Curzon had carried out the partition.

new.s: The Delhi Durbar of 1903 celebrated the coronation of:
new.x: The 1903 Durbar celebrated Edward VII's coronation; the 1911 Durbar of George V annulled the partition.

new.s: After the partition of 1905, the rest of Bengal had a population of 54 million, in which:
new.x: Of 54 million, only 18 million were Bengalis against 36 million Biharis and Oriyas, so Bengalis became a minority in their own province.

new.s: K.K. Mitra first suggested the boycott of British goods in which weekly (13 July 1905)?
new.x: Krishna Kumar Mitra first suggested boycott in his weekly Sanjibani on 13 July 1905.

new.s: The Swadesh Bandhab Samiti of Barisal used which of these?
new.x: Ashwini Kumar Dutt's Swadesh Bandhab Samiti used magic lanterns, social work and arbitration courts.

new.s: The Calcutta session of the INC (1906), which declared Swaraj the goal, was presided over by:
new.x: Dadabhai Naoroji presided at Calcutta (1906), where resolutions on Swaraj, Swadeshi, Boycott and National Education were passed.

new.s: Who was the first principal of the Andhra Jateeya Kalasala, Machilipatnam (1910)?
new.x: Kopalle Hanumantha Rao was its first principal; Konda Venkatappayya inaugurated it.

new.s: The Banga Lakshmi Cotton Mills were set up in 1906:
new.x: Banga Lakshmi Cotton Mills (1906) were set up by public subscription; P.C. Ray founded Bengal Chemical Swadeshi Stores.

new.s: Which Swadeshi bank was founded in 1907?
new.x: Among Swadeshi banks, Bank of India came in 1906 and Indian Bank in 1907.

new.s: Who painted 'Bharat Mata' (1905)?
new.x: Abanindranath Tagore painted Bharat Mata in 1905.

new.s: The Indian Society of Oriental Art (1907) was founded by Abanindranath Tagore and:
new.x: Abanindranath and Gaganendranath Tagore founded the Indian Society of Oriental Art (1907) of the Bengal School.

new.s: Tilak started the Shivaji festival in:
new.x: Tilak began Ganeshotsav in 1893 and the Shivaji festival in 1895.

new.s: Which pair is correctly matched?
o: Amar Sonar Bangla – Bankim Chandra Chatterjee
new.x: Desher Katha (1904) is by S.G. Deuskar; Bande Mataram is Bankim's, Amar Sonar Bangla Tagore's and Hindu Desa Daridryam Attili Suryanarayana Rao's.

new.s: Which leader was NOT part of the trio Lal-Bal-Pal?
new.x: Lal-Bal-Pal were Lajpat Rai, Tilak and Pal; Aurobindo appears only in 'Lal-Bal-Pal-Ghosh'.

new.s: Which leader of the Extremist era was associated with Delhi?
new.x: Syed Haider Raza led in Delhi; Ashwini Kumar Dutt was in Bengal, Chidambaram Pillai in Madras and Lajpat Rai in Punjab.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about Aurobindo Ghosh:
1. He edited Bande Mataram.
2. He was convicted in the Alipore case.
3. He retired to Pondicherry.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Aurobindo edited Bande Mataram and retired to Pondicherry; he was acquitted, not convicted, in the Alipore case.

new.s: The All-India Muslim League was founded on 30 December 1906 at:
new.x: It was founded at Dacca at the All-India Muhammadan Educational Conference.

new.s: Who was the first (honorary) president of the All-India Muslim League?
new.x: Aga Khan III was its first honorary president; the proposal came from Nawab Salimullah.

new.s: Separate electorates for Muslims were granted by the reforms of:
new.x: The Morley-Minto Reforms of 1909, following the Simla Deputation (1906), gave Muslims separate electorates.

new.s: Who was the Moderate nominee for president at the Surat session (1907)?
new.x: Rash Behari Ghosh was the Moderate nominee; the Extremists wanted Tilak or Lajpat Rai.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the Surat Split:
1. The Extremists wanted the session at Nagpur.
2. Minto called it 'a great triumph for us'.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Both are correct: the session was moved from Nagpur to Surat, and Minto welcomed the split as a great triumph.

new.s: The Moderates and Extremists reunited at the INC session of:
new.x: The Extremists re-entered the Congress at Lucknow in 1916, the year of the Lucknow Pact.

new.s: Which of the following belongs to the Extremist phase of the national movement?
new.x: The Swadeshi movement and the Surat Split (1907) are of the Extremist phase; Morley-Minto was a government response and Home Rule and the Lucknow Pact were the reunion phase.

new.s: Tilak's Home Rule League was started in:
new.x: Tilak's Home Rule League began in April 1916, Besant's in September 1916.

new.s: Which event took place in December 1905?
o: National Council of Education set up
new.x: In December 1905 the Banaras INC under Gokhale backed Swadeshi; the Muslim League came in Dec 1906, Surat in Dec 1907 and the NCE in Aug 1906.

new.s: How many students of the Rajahmundry college were suspended after the 1907 Vandemataram incident?
new.x: 138 of 222 students were suspended, marking the start of student participation in Andhra.

new.s: The Andhra phase of the Vandemataram movement lasted from:
new.x: The Andhra phase ran from 1906 to 1911, ending with the annulment of the partition.

new.s: Who presided over Bipin Chandra Pal's lectures at Kakinada on 17 April 1907?
new.x: Kattiventi Perraju presided at Kakinada; T. Prakasam presided over Pal's Madras meeting.

new.s: At Machilipatnam in 1907, Bipin Chandra Pal's stay was arranged by:
new.x: Brahmo Ramadasu Naidu arranged Pal's stay at Machilipatnam; at Rajahmundry he stayed at Madella Sourayya's house.

new.s: Pal's hosts at Vijayawada (24 April 1907) were Munagala Raja and:
new.x: Munagala Raja and Nayani Venkata Rangarao hosted Pal at Vijayawada.

new.s: The 138 students punished after the Rajahmundry college incident were debarred from examinations for:
new.x: The 138 students were debarred from exams for two years; Gadicherla was expelled and blacklisted.

new.s: Who co-organised the students' address to Bipin Chandra Pal at Rajahmundry with Gadicherla Harisarvottama Rao?
new.x: J. Ramachandra Rao co-organised the address that Gadicherla presented to Pal in defiance of the ban.

new.s: The Bala Bharathi Samiti was formed at Rajahmundry in:
new.x: Local youths formed the Bala Bharathi Samiti at Rajahmundry in February 1907.

new.s: The Young Men's Swarajya Samiti was formed during Pal's visit to:
new.x: The Young Men's Swarajya Samiti was formed at Machilipatnam on 27 April 1907.

new.s: Who backed the Bala Bharathi Samiti of Rajahmundry?
new.x: Karanam Guneswara Rao backed the Samiti; Mutnuri Krishna Rao organised Pal's tour but did not found it.

new.s: Which body hosted Bipin Chandra Pal at Rajahmundry in 1907?
new.x: The Young Men's Association of Rajahmundry was Pal's host body there.

new.s: The Andhra Jatheeya Vidya Parishad was set up at Machilipatnam on 17 November 1907 by:
new.x: Kopalle Hanumantha Rao set up the Andhra Jatheeya Vidya Parishad at Machilipatnam in 1907.

new.s: Who set up the Godavari Swadeshi Store at Rajahmundry (1907)?
new.x: Karanam Guneswara Rao set it up; Bipin Chandra Pal inaugurated it.

new.s: The first Telugu national song 'Hinduvulara ennaall ee gati' was written by:
new.x: Chilakamarti Lakshmi Narasimham wrote 'Hinduvulara ennaall ee gati', the first Telugu national song.

new.s: Which journal was edited by Chilakamarti Lakshmi Narasimham?
new.x: Desamata was Chilakamarti's journal; Swarajya was Gadicherla's and Krishna Patrika Mutnuri Krishna Rao's.

new.s: The Swarajya article that spoke of a cruel foreign tiger devouring Indians was titled:
new.x: 'Viparita Buddhi' spoke of a cruel foreign (English) tiger and led to the sedition charge.

new.s: In the Swarajya case (1908), Gadicherla Harisarvottama Rao was sentenced to:
new.x: He and Bodi Narayana Rao got 3 years' rigorous imprisonment, becoming the first Telugu political prisoners.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the Swarajya case:
1. Gadicherla and Bodi Narayana Rao were arrested on 18 July 1908.
2. The accused became the first Telugu political prisoners.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Both are correct: they were arrested on 18 July 1908 and became the first Telugu political prisoners.

new.s: How many people died in the Kotappakonda riots of February 1909?
new.x: Fourteen died in the police clash at Kotappakonda near Narasaraopet.

new.s: The Kakinada riots of 31 May 1907 began when a boy shouting Vande Mataram was beaten by:
new.x: Surgeon Dr Kemp beat the boy Kompelli Krishna Rao, after which the European Club was attacked.

new.s: Which event of the Andhra Vandemataram movement took place in 1910?
o: Founding of the Andhra Jateeya Kalasala
Founding of the Bala Bharathi Samiti
new.x: The Andhra Jateeya Kalasala was founded at Machilipatnam in 1910; the Kakinada riots were in 1907, the Bala Bharathi Samiti in 1907 and the Tenali case in 1909.
